Subject: Lumina AI - Dedicated capacity acceptance checklist and orchestration

Alex — thanks, that helps. I pulled together a short acceptance checklist and timeline to validate the fleet sizing and cutover cadence before your Reserved Capacity go-live. Attaching an editable checklist but pasted key items below so you have immediate visibility.

Key acceptance items (short):
- Baseline synthetic and replay tests: 24h replay on a staging pool using representative traffic (we recommend 72h if you want extra confidence).
- KV cache hit rate targets: > 18% after warmup for recommendation endpoints.
- Throughput validation: sustained 60 qps with < 10% CPU/GPU throttling margin.
- Performance regression threshold: p95 latency increase <= 10% vs hosted baseline.
- Failover policy test: model fallback to smaller quantized variant within 200ms on node failure.
- Cost forecast sanity check: unit token cost delta from hosted to reserved.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): schedule staging replay + perm test creds (we need procurement E2E approvals).
- Week 1: run staging replay, capture perf metrics and KV cache stats.
- Week 2: iterate quantization/batching params and rerun acceptance tests.
- Week 3: smoke cutover window (2-3 hr): DNS routing test, capacity scale checks, toggle canary traffic at 10/50/100%.

Attachments: lumina_capacity_acceptance_checklist.xlsx, precutover-runbook.md

Can Marissa and Karthik weigh in on the orchestration steps and any mandatory procurement gating? Happy to sync with procurement if that helps accelerate approvals.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
